reason: Owner Quest 2 feedback: stats HUD follows left controller but is too close to read, and opening menus worsens Sheep Tag lag. v11.278 moves the existing native wrist metrics panel 12 cm farther forward and 6 cm higher, reuses a single scratch vector in native XR tracking, and throttles stats texture repaints to ~1.85s while preserving instant page changes and the L3 toggle. Adds Nerd Stats fourth page with approximate XR callback frame times for stats/radial menu open/closed combinations and sample counts so owner can isolate menu cost at fixed house count. No change to gameplay AI, camera, LAN authority, menus or particle editor. Quest scenes at 38 houses/3092 draws/10 FPS vs 17 houses/1806 draws/26 FPS suggest substantial scene-load contribution, not proof of menu root cause. Fully verified 309-patch source and 69 assets, 8,111,652 assembled HTML bytes, SHA-256 046c28a36a95ce89827e7c8b753fe289189e803e6cd76fba8d0141195625d89a. Real Quest 2 UX/performance acceptance pending.
